author: Allison
description: September 2026 brought deeper visibility into your work: explore pull requests without leaving chat, bring the AI model your team trusts, and fix vulnerable packages the moment Visual Studio flags… The post GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio — September update appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: September 2026 brought deeper visibility into your work: explore pull requests without leaving chat, bring the AI model your team trusts, and fix vulnerable packages the moment Visual Studio flags them. Highlights Here’s what’s new with GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio 2026.
takeaways: Fix NuGet Vulnerabilities from the Error List : NuGet Audit warnings in the Error List now include a fixer action that opens GitHub Copilot Chat in agent mode and asks Copilot to fix the vulnerable packages using the NuGet MCP server.
This functionality requires signing in to GitHub Copilot and enabling the NuGet MCP server from the Copilot Chat tools menu.
Open GitHub Copilot Chat, select the Git agent, and attach a pull request as context from the Git Repository window to get a summary with navigable links to the underlying comments and files.
